scenario.title: Test 3: Cash Income Disqualification
dialogue: It's a commercial shop in Lajpat Nagar.
Yes, original title deed is with me.
I am self-employed running a grocery store, and all my income is in cash.

final_state.disqualification_reason: Cash income mode is strictly ineligible. Income must be credited to a bank account.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Vikas Verma, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Vikas Verma?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: It's a commercial shop in Lajpat Nagar.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Got that. Is this property in your sole ownership, or is it jointly owned with someone else?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. Do you have the original property documents available for physical verification?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, original title deed is with me.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Understood. What is the approximate loan amount you are looking to borrow?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Could you share whether you are salaried or self-employed, and whether your income is received through bank deposit or in cash?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: I am self-employed running a grocery store, and all my income is in cash.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you for letting me know, Vikas Verma. To qualify for this Loan Against Property offer, income must be routed through verified bank credit channels. Because your income is received in cash, we cannot process this specific pre-approved offer. We appreciate your time and trust in Home Credit!
